_comment: Channel -> MaleCNS cell types. Types are matched by EXACT name against the loaded graph;
a trailing '*' expands by prefix, which is how you catch MaleCNS's split populations
(DNg02 does not exist; DNg02_a .. DNg02_g do). Candidates are listed best-first and every
name that is present is used, so one file works on both the toy graph and the real connectome.
steer and forward are deliberately empty: fill them from find_pursuit_circuit, then calibrate.

loom_speed.note: Angular-velocity-sensitive lobula columnar neuron; drives the giant fibre.

loom_size.note: Looming-size selective; the other main giant-fibre input.

target.note: Small-object tracking used in courtship pursuit. Split left/right to steer.

sound.note: Johnston's organ B1 subtypes; declared electrical partners of the giant fibre.

arousal.note: P1/pC1 courtship state. A tonic gate, not a direction: in FLYCNS these drive the song command neurons (pMP2, DNp13, pIP10), not locomotion. First three are real-connectome names, the rest exist on the toy graph.

gf.note: The giant fibre. One or two spikes per loom, then it adapts, so treat a spike as a trigger event and never as a rate.

jump.note: Tergotrochanteral (jump) motor neuron: the giant fibre's output.

flight_power.note: Peripherally synapsing interneuron; recruits the power muscles for the escape.

steer.note: TODO: bilateral descending neurons whose left-right imbalance yaws the drone. Rank candidates with find_pursuit_circuit, then verify with calibrate().

forward.note: TODO: descending neurons whose rate sets forward speed. Decoded gain-only (no intercept) so arousal=0 hovers.
